C0085.title: Douyin Streamer Detained for Cross-Platform Traffic Redirection to Overseas Accounts via VPN
C0085.summary: Douyin platform detected users purchasing VPN circumvention software to post pornographic content on overseas social platforms and redirect followers to offshore accounts for illicit traffic. The platform promptly disabled relevant accounts and assisted investigations, leading to the criminal detention of three individuals.
